profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | TypeScript, React, C#, Python
profile.summary:
With a B.S. in Computer Science and 3+ years of experience developing secure, scalable web and mobile applications in the healthcare space, I’ve gained comprehensive skills in both backend and frontend development, as well as meaningful exposure to the challenges and needs of the healthcare industry.

As a strong communicator, I excel at bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders. I am committed to continuous learning and am always eager to take on new challenges. Let's connect and explore opportunities!

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the planning, development, and maintenance of white-labeled digital health solutions for major healthcare organizations. Projects included custom patient portal apps supporting over 100,000 monthly active users, enhancing patient engagement, registration, and retention
- Engineered performant, React-based UIs by using RTK to manage complex application state and data caching, and applying strong TypeScript practices to enforce correctness and reduce bugs
- Designed and maintained RESTful APIs using C# and .NET by following principles of test-driven development (TDD), dependency inversion, and clean coding practices
- Defined architecture and tech stack for new products in collaboration with stakeholders and other developers. Created prototypes, wrote design documents, and addressed feedback to ensure our solution was scalable, secure, and HIPAA compliant
- Collaborated with designers to create a reusable React component library, styled with Tailwind CSS, and tested through Storybook
- Took the lead on numerous projects, working cross-functionally to define requirements, write user stories, delegate tasks, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality features

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked as a Full Stack Developer at Epic Systems, the leading Electronic Health Record (EHR) system in the U.S., specializing in Tapestry, Epic’s managed care application.
- Modeled and interacted with complex health data using MUMPS, an integrated database language that communicates with Chronicles, a NoSQL database
- Designed and maintained a web-based interface using C#, TypeScript, React.js, HTML, and CSS, adhering to a Model View ViewModel (MVVM) architecture
- Assumed leadership responsibilities, organizing and leading meetings to drive project progress and success
- Regularly interacted with customers to address pertinent issues

projects.title: Virtual Reality Music Visualizer
projects.description: As a capstone to my interdisciplinary arts minor and a fusion between two of my favorite things, I am currently working to create a virtual-reality music visualization application. Through Unity, I am building a 3D environment that visually reacts based on spectrum data being fed in from an audio file.

projects.title: Align - Android Yoga Application for Senior Design
projects.description: Align is an Android application that checks a user’s yoga form using live video feed, suggesting areas for improvement via audio and visual feedback. Along with a group of two other students, we are building this application around Tensorflow's PoseNet pose recognition AI. In addition to live video feedback, the application offers many other features such as a workout builder, personal stats, and a customized home page.
